entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: On 19 January 1996, the mutilated remains of 19-year-old Diao Aiqing were found across multiple locations on or near Nanjing University in Jiangsu, China. Diao Aiqing, who had disappeared nine days prior, had been dismembered into over 2,000 pieces. The case remains unsolved and is one of the most notorious crimes in the city.
